notes.title: PUZZLE FEST AND DISCOUNTS!
notes.content:
Hey there, friends! 

Long time no see. But here we are with some big news for you! 

[h2]PUZZLE FEST![/h2]
That's right! We're taking part in the Puzzle Fest starting today, April, 24th - don't miss out on the opportunity to fiddle with our match-3 games full of joy and love! To celebrate this festival we've set up a discount of 50% off! 

On to the next topic! 

[h2]THE GRAND UPDATE IS COMING![/h2]
This summer all our players will get a surprise. Now that I've said that in the subtitle, it's no longer a surprise. But hear me out: Sex And The Furry Titty will get the sound work on sex scenes, updated animations and graphics and even more little changes here and there, so there's even more opportunities to freshen up your memories by playing the game after the update!

[h2]CHANGING THE COST[/h2]
Time goes by, we evolve and we need our price tag to evolve, too. 

After Puzzle Fest discounts are gone, Sex And The Furry Titty will raise in price a little so that we can continue making new games and update older ones for you for free! 

So, if you have ever considered picking up a copy of any of our games, now is the [b]perfect[/b] time to do so.

notes.title: Free Story Update News
notes.content:
Hi, friends!

First of all let me tell you about the upcoming free story update. It’s still at least a month out, but we’ve made enough progress so I can finally share the details with you!

This story is about Robyn, a polyamorous sex blogger. She’s getting a bit stir crazy, being stuck at home all alone, longing for some action. Unfortunately, both her partners are unavailable, so she has to settle for a fresh shipment of sex toys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39859396/a3e70857acc972b9273f6ea557498384a07b43ea.png[/img]

Luckily, the toys are all great, and she’ll be able to come up with a number of ways to enjoy them! Some of them even come with the suction cups, and her shower stall has some nice smooth glass panes. And they are quite sturdy as well!

We’re going to add the option to choose from different toys (and in some cases outfits) to this story, just like in the Boutique story. And speaking of that, we’d like to ask for your opinions. Do you enjoy being able to see the scene with different clothing sets? Is this whole thing worth it? We can’t do polls here, so please leave a comment and share your thoughts with us!


[h2]Next update[/h2]
In the meantime, we should finally release the bonus art update next week! Most of the new things seem to be working, but we need to actually test it before unleashing it on you. The new bonus artwork are going to appear in the story trees:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39859396/f97a418107cf42b650ee1c99e4676daaaa5ee4ec.png[/img]

And when you fulfill a special objective, you’ll get access to the full artwork! (No, this is not the full artwork, and yes, I added the melons myself)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39859396/6e5df29edcba23916b56fec54f23becd1f4d1aa8.png[/img]

In addition to this, we’ll have another go at fixing the stories not launching, and all the other bugs manifesting in the match-3 mode.

[h2]Community items and possible dlc[/h2]
Our artists are a bit busy, but we are working on the community items to go with the trading cards and all the other goodies. We have some things planned already, like animated stickers and at least one animated profile background, but we were wondering if we should make more stuff. Would any of you like to see animated profile pictures, for example? If you want them, please let us know which characters you’d like to see the most in the comments!

And if you have other ideas for the community items, please let us know as well! We’d like to do everything, of course, turn every character into an avatar, a sticker, a background, but we have limited resources, so we really should prioritize doing items you good folks actually want to see.

One person on the forum suggested we do an Art DLC, just a pack of hi-res uncompressed images from the game. We think it’s a great idea, and once we have some time, we’ll make one, and we’ll try to include some sketches and other bonus materials there as well!

[h2]Closing thoughts[/h2]
That’s all for this news item. Stay tuned for the update, the DLC, and for more big announcements! You can probably guess what we’ll announce next, but we’ll wait until we have at least some art to post. And we need to make a page, too. Oh, I probably said too much, oops.

With love,
- Felix

notes.title: It's here!
notes.content:
It's here!

5 new stories, most considerably longer than the ones in LS1, new artists and writers. It's all available to play right now!

We hope you like the game, and even if you don't, please leave your feedback and a review! The reviews are lifeblood for all the games on this platform, and we really need your support!

Still, the last month of development was really rough due to our main dev's illness, so we're preparing a whole bunch of updates over the next few days/weeks.


[h1]Post-release support[/h1]

First of all, the game balance is very uneven right now. We couldn't properly test the levels due to not having a working build till the last few days, so we'll do a balancing pass first. Expect the update as soon as tomorrow.

Then we'll add the bonus artworks I was talking about in one of the previous posts. The artworks themselves are done, but the special unlock conditions need to be added into the game, this should happen next week or so.

And, of course, we'll be fixing bugs along the way. This release is a bit jumbled, no doubt, but we'll make sure the games works well and every bit of content is where it should be before moving on.


[h1]Content updates[/h1]

As long as this launch is not a total disaster, we already have a FREE bonus story planned, same deal as with the Shades of Gay. Expect it in about two or three months, maybe a tiny bit sooner.

We are also planning to add an art gallery for all the cool concept art we have.

[h1]Next Game[/h1]

Our original plan was to release this game in May and announce or next one right about now, this month being Pride month and all that. We need to sort out the release of the Furry Titty first, but the announcement is still coming!

Stay tuned for more news, updates and announcements!

With love,
- Felix
